newsitem.title: USA: Neuberger & Berman sets annual dividend.
newsitem.headline: Neuberger & Berman sets annual dividend.

text.p: The Neuberger & Berman NYCDC Socially Responsive Trust set an annual dividend of $0.16 from income and an annual capital gain distribution of $1.19 on Friday.
The annual capital gain distribution consists of $0.56 from short-term and $0.63 from long-term.
In 1995 the company set an annual dividend of $0.12 from income and an annual capital gain distribution of $0.31 -- $0.16 from short-term and $0.15 from long-term.
The 1996 dividend and distribution record and payable date is December 27 1996.
